segments.contextBefore: The following code shows an example of using [`vvcopysign(_:_:_:_:)`](vvcopysign(_:_:_:_:).md).
segments.contextAfter:
```swift
var x: [Double] = [-1, -1, 1, 1]
var y: [Double] = [1.2, 5.5, -16, 26.0]
var z = [Double](repeating: 0, count: x.count)
var n = Int32(x.count)
 
vvcopysign(&z, &y, &x, &n)
 
print(z) // [-1.2, -5.5, 16.0, 26.0]
```
